svg.title: Martian expansion: 1024 colors
svg.desc: 48 artist-derived hue families: 13 shades and tints each, eight muted companions each, and sixteen neutral grays. White outlines identify Warren Mars’s 120 original RGB anchors.

g.text: 120 original anchors preserved · 24 original + 24 intermediate hue families
